title: Periodical repairs and maintenance of DGNSS Aerial Mast towers at Minicoy Lighthouse & DGNSS station.
summary: Periodical repairs and maintenance of the DGNSS aerial mast towers at Minicoy Lighthouse and DGNSS station, Minicoy Island, Lakshadweep, tendered by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Minicoy Lighthouse & DGNSS station, Minicoy Island, UT of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Periodical repairs and maintenance of DGNSS aerial mast towers

scope.item: Periodical repairs and maintenance of DGNSS Aerial Mast towers (no BOQ in this notice)

money.notes: EMD by Demand Draft/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by post or in person by 11.11.2024 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR, for contractors from Lakshadweep, work experience with any Government department during last 05 years in island works
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
notes: Notice only (Section I); no BOQ or specification of the masts. Bid download/submission 15.10.2024 10:00 to 12.11.2024 15:00; bid query last date 28.10.2024. Station matched to Minicoy South (the Minicoy DGNSS station per station list); notice itself says only 'Minicoy Lighthouse & DGNSS station'.
